questions.q: Besides control flow and data flow, what else does a package (.dtsx) contain?
options: Connection managers, event handlers, variables, parameters, and logging
Nothing else — a package is only ever control flow and data flow
Other complete projects, nested inside it
A copy of the SSISDB catalog
questions.explain: A package is an organized collection of tasks, containers, data flow elements, connection managers, event handlers, variables, parameters, and logging configuration.

questions.q: What must a package's control flow include before it can have a data flow at all?
options: A Data Flow Task
A For Loop container
A project-level connection manager
A SQL Server Agent job
questions.explain: A data flow only exists inside a Data Flow Task; the control flow must include one before sources, transformations, and destinations can be added.

questions.q: What is a project, in relation to packages?
options: A container that holds one or more packages, plus shared connection managers and parameters
A single package renamed for production use
A synonym for the SSISDB catalog
A file extension, not an actual container
questions.explain: A project is the container you develop in — it holds one or more packages along with project-level connection managers and project parameters.

questions.q: What is a solution, in relation to projects?
options: A container that groups one or more projects, useful when your work spans more than one project type
The same thing as a project, just a different file extension
A folder that only ever contains a single Integration Services project
A feature of the SSISDB catalog, not of SSDT
questions.explain: A solution is one level up from a project — it groups one or more projects, which can include different project types (e.g. Integration Services alongside Reporting Services).

questions.q: Which file extension belongs to a package versus a project versus a solution?
options: .dtsx is a package, .dtproj is a project, .sln is a solution
.sln is a package, .dtproj is a solution, .dtsx is a project
All three use the same .dtsx extension
.dtproj is a package, .dtsx is a project, .sln is unrelated to SSIS
questions.explain: .dtsx files are individual packages, .dtproj is the project file listing those packages, and .sln is the solution file listing the projects it contains.
